resolution.note: src/hook/shell-reader.ts is the one shell reader scope, commit-format, unpushed-delete and heavy-command import; their tokenizers are gone; test/hook/shell-reader.test.ts checks quoting rows against real bash and every reproduced review case at its hook

title: refactor(hook): the Bash hooks read a command through one shell reader
body:
src/hook/scope.ts, commit-format.ts and unpushed-delete.ts each re-parse a Bash command with their own regexes and miss shell grouping, wrappers (env, subshell, command substitution) and multi-source state.
Outcome: the three hooks import one shell command reader and no hook keeps its own tokenizer; node --test over test/hook exits 0.
Proof: the existing hook tests plus one reader test pass against the shared module.
